sourceEvidence.title: Director of New Launch Management
sourceEvidence.quote:
Production Process Development

- Define and continuously refine the end-to-end production process for new product launches, from formula brief through bulk production and quality release.
- Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Project Management, and Creative to build workflows that scale as the portfolio grows.
- Document processes clearly enough that the team can execute consistently without this role in every room.
- Lead the creation and maintenance of new item documentation across the portfolio, including BOMs, assembly instructions, and product standards, partnering with Product Development and third-party vendors to ensure specs are accurate and production-ready.
